profile.headline: Software Developer at Bento for Business
profile.summary:
Creative problem solver, object-oriented coder, and finder of zen with well-named variables.

Prior to software development I worked in the culinary field, honing my skills in effective teamwork, time management, and customer satisfaction.

When away from the computer, I enjoy meandering around Chicago on my never-ending quest for the city's best Thai noodles.
